description: Use when you need the native coin balance (ETH or POL) of an address on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: wei and a decimal amount from a public node, with the block number and as_of. Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/native-balance, $0.001 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Native coin on one chain only; for stablecoins or several chains use wallet_balance. With a P0 access key (header Authorization: Bearer p0k_…, buy one at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) this tool makes the paid call itself and returns the data, deducting the listed price.
name: evm_native_balance
title: EVM native balance
